The tasks.body: Seven hand-written fixtures. Each one lists the tools a careful person would call, in order, and what the agent starts with. Two of them check safety instead: one chain the guard must block, and one task whose input type nothing in the graph can produce.

The scores.body: Chain recall is the share of required tools that came back. Order is the share of fixtures where the method returns a run order that matches the fixture; a flat list scores 0. Disambiguation is the share of fixtures with every required tool present and no rival tool of the same capability, like the three different search_issues.

What counts as tokens.body: cl100k over each tool's name, description and input schema, for every tool handed to the agent. Preload-all hands over all of them, top-k hands over k, and Switchboard hands over the plan.

Baselines.body: Preload-all, and BM25 top-5 and top-10 over the same tool text. Same tasks, same tokenizer, same machine.

Hardware.body: Saved with every results file. The recorded run: 8-vCPU Xeon, HydraDB v0.4.0 debug build, everything local. No release build was measured.
